hypothesis: W-R24 found the frozen W-R22 model's zero-row feature is brittle. A feature-only current-observation row detector recognizing all-zero, all-255, or exact previous-row repeat can restore robustness across coding formats without changing model training, parameters, input channels or labels.
freeze: Preserve predefined three formats, two masking counts, three generator families and two local swap sites. Freeze detector rule and every criterion before first-use. Scientific finding is a hand-engineered interface correction, not automatically learned representation.
training: Both candidate representations use the IDENTICAL weights and bias from frozen W-R22 maskaware_augmented train() on its original development seeds240..255, 1728 paired examples and 32 perceptron epochs. No new fit or normalization. Confirm new feature agrees with prior maskaware feature on all original W-R22 training examples.
arms: observed_multi_marker_detector: same 16 repeated top-two transition residuals, omitting edges around candidate rows equal to all0, all255, or exactly preceding observed candidate row; all decisions from input data only
primary: Report 18 heldout cells per arm, each with per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN. REPRESENTATION_BENEFIT iff new feature achieves >=0.80 accuracy in EVERY cell and >=0.10 aggregate accuracy gain over old feature. PARTIAL iff new aggregate > old by >=0.05 but strict threshold fails. NO_GAIN otherwise. Always retain adverse formats and controls.
controls: No explicit mask oracle, privileged missing-position metadata or extra input channel passed to feature model
Exactly identical learned weights/bias and 16-wide trained model for both arms; any gain is rule-based preprocessing not newly learned cognition
Positive/negative candidate anchor and multiset paired-identical; swapped actual rows always unmasked
Frozen exact predecessor Git blob and original first-use artifact; one full Go integration test/build
claim_limit: Controlled synthetic observed-row coding correction, not general intelligence.
